capabilities.name: Project creation, open, and local binding
Scene manuscript editor with autosave
Portable project brief and act, chapter, scene, beat planning
capabilities.scope_note: The active Plan workspace stores synopsis, genre, themes, style guide, outline, acts, chapters, scene placement, beats, story-time positions, labels, and a Character Arc overview in versioned project files. Dragging previews affected chapters, crossed scenes, act-boundary risk, and neighboring story-time markers before the move is committed.

capabilities.name: Evidence-backed Change Set generation, hunk review, apply, Revision, restore, and undo
capabilities.scope_note: The verified loop creates concrete Change Sets, supports include/exclude, direct edit, regeneration, and author-comment revision per deterministic hunk, enforces protected text, previews Story Memory impact, creates coordinated multi-scene AI groups, applies those groups atomically, records content-addressed Revisions, compares history, selectively restores, and undoes. Packaged GUI automation remains open.

capabilities.name: Contextual project chat with citations and durable artifact promotion
capabilities.scope_note: Assistant conversations have explicit Book, Scene, Chapter, Character, and Storyline scopes with bounded context. Replies can become Change Sets, review-first Story Memory suggestions, visible project or scene notes, or non-destructive Storyline experiments. The packaged Book-scope and promotion paths passed manual product validation; automated rendered promotion coverage remains open.

capabilities.name: Structured Story Memory entries, relationships, and review-first suggestions
capabilities.scope_note: Story Memory supports typed details, aliases, tags, categories, notes, AI visibility, book/series scope, temporal relationships, evidence-linked suggestions, correction before acceptance, and bulk accept/defer/exclude. The rendered workflow verifies correction and bulk acceptance while preserving the non-canon review boundary.

capabilities.name: Manuscript-wide prose, planning, and Story Memory search
Reusable built-in and custom Editorial Pass library
capabilities.scope_note: Built-in and custom Passes are portable, the Change Set composer can apply them, and an author-facing builder captures goal, instruction, and readable evaluation criteria. The committed seven-genre, seven-Pass regression corpus measures 1.0 targeted issue reduction with zero protected-term or introduced-name canon errors.

capabilities.name: Deterministic manuscript hygiene checks
capabilities.scope_note: This is manuscript hygiene, not the evidence-backed Story Memory diagnostics planned for Phase E.

capabilities.name: Temporal Canon Facts, knowledge, setups/payoffs, and evidence-backed diagnostics
capabilities.scope_note: Canon Facts, validity, manuscript evidence, knowledge state, temporal relationships, setups/payoffs, open questions, Character Arc states and conflicts, dispositions, incremental affected-scene diagnostics, Change Set impact, and a seven-scenario measured diagnostic corpus are active. Broader design-partner genre data remains a release-readiness gate.

capabilities.name: Branch creation, comparison, conflict resolution, and merge
capabilities.scope_note: The active UI exposes guided merge primitives; the author-facing Storylines product is planned for Phase F.

capabilities.name: Named Storyline experiments with briefs, comparison, and selective Change Set integration
capabilities.scope_note: Storylines support experiment briefs, lifecycle actions, branch-backed isolation, coordinated multi-scene AI Change Sets, semantic arc/fact/setup/question deltas, pre/post impact summaries, and selective integration as atomically applied coordinated Change Sets.

capabilities.name: Author-controlled project Style Profile
capabilities.scope_note: Authors explicitly select exemplar scenes; the resulting descriptive metrics guide generation without imitating an external author.

capabilities.name: Three-direction creative generation and outcome comparison
capabilities.scope_note: Alternatives compare editorial intent, hunk scope, word delta, voice shape, Story Memory impact, and Canon risk before the author chooses a direction.

capabilities.name: Intent-aware Revision retrospectives
capabilities.scope_note: Revision comparison summarizes changed scenes and word deltas, linked intent and accepted hunks, Story Memory changes, and remaining diagnostics or unresolved setups.

capabilities.name: Generation budget policy and usage controls
Basic generation run visibility
capabilities.scope_note: The active V2 surface is a read-only history table; comparison, rerun, pinning, export, and hardening controls are not presented as shipped.

capabilities.name: Commit-aware retrieval and cited Assistant context
capabilities.scope_note: Citations are available in Assistant chat; the full generation and proposal provenance viewer is not yet restored in V2.

capabilities.name: Staged Markdown, TXT, DOCX, and Scrivener import plus Markdown and DOCX export
capabilities.scope_note: New-project import includes structure preview, Scrivener Draft binder ordering with RTF extraction, compile exclusions, and export loss reports; packaged native automation and richer formatting fidelity remain open.

capabilities.name: Atomic scene save with crash-recovery journal
capabilities.scope_note: Unsaved scene title/body drafts are journaled locally and prompt Restore or Discard on reopen; a forced process-termination native drill is still required.

capabilities.name: Startup health checks and guided safe repair
capabilities.scope_note: Project load checks directories, write access, revision storage, scene integrity, Codex storage, disk space, and the Python runtime. Blocking failures expose a safe repair action; clean-machine packaged-app automation remains open.

capabilities.name: On-device content-free activation and trust dashboard
capabilities.scope_note: A strict allowlist records only content-free scalar events inside the local project. The Settings dashboard shows golden-loop milestones, active days, review decisions, apply/undo depth, retention controls, and an on-device collection toggle. No external telemetry transport exists.

capabilities.name: Workspace audit, repair, and performance baseline
capabilities.scope_note: Available through CLI while the V2 recovery experience is designed.

capabilities.name: Checksum-pinned embedded Python core and supervised sidecar
capabilities.scope_note: A real macOS application bundle has been built and its isolated embedded core verified. Developer ID signing, Apple notarization, both-architecture CI artifacts, and packaged GUI automation must pass before release readiness.

capabilities.name: Voice commands and dictation helpers
capabilities.scope_note: Helper logic remains tested, but Voice is intentionally hidden until the golden loop is proven.

capabilities.name: Generation rerun, comparison, pinning, and export
capabilities.scope_note: Pure helpers and core commands exist, but the active V2 product does not claim this workflow.
